query_string:
with TY as (
    select
    {hierachy_list} --dynamic
    {kpi_formula} as {kpi_name}  --dynamic
    from `{table_name}` s
    where 
    s.week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id} and s.week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}  {filter_condition}  --dynamic
    {hierachy_list_group_by}  --dynamic
    )
    ,LY as (
    select
    {hierachy_list} --dynamic
    {kpi_formula} as {kpi_name}  --dynamic
    from `{table_name}` s
    where s.week_id <= {compare_end_week_id} and s.week_id >= {compare_start_week_id}  {filter_condition}   --dynamic
    {hierachy_list_group_by}
    )
    select
    {combined_coalesce_list}
    round(TY.{kpi_name}, 2) as {kpi_name}_TY
    ,round(safe_divide((TY.{kpi_name}-LY.{kpi_name}),LY.{kpi_name}),2) as {kpi_name}_LY_variance
    from TY
    full outer join LY 
    on {full_join_ly} --dynamic

query_string:
SELECT 
    SUBSTR(CAST(week_id AS STRING), 1, 4) AS fiscal_year,
    week_id,
    Event_Name,
    Event_Type,
    SUM(Attendance) as Attendance,
    SUM(Revenue_Generated) as Revenue_Generated
    FROM {brand_table}
    where ((week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id} and week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id}) or 
    (week_id >= {compare_start_week_id} and week_id <= {compare_end_week_id}))
    group by fiscal_year, Event_Name, Event_Type, week_id

{% set style = config['prod_lower_level'] %}
{% set store_code = config['loc_lower_level'] %}

{% if config['loc_lower_level'] in loc_level and config['prod_lower_level'] in prod_level %}

        WITH ThisYear AS (
            SELECT 
                SAFE_DIVIDE(
                    SUM(s.discount_amount), 
                    SUM(s.sales + s.discount_amount)
                ) AS Launch_Discount_TY
            FROM {sales_table} s
            LEFT JOIN {product_attribute_table} p
                ON ({join})
            WHERE week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}
            AND week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id}
            {filter_condition}
            AND s.clearance_flag = false
            AND p.product_identifier = "new_style"
        ),
        LastYear AS (
            SELECT 
                SAFE_DIVIDE(
                    SUM(s.discount_amount), 
                    SUM(s.sales + s.discount_amount)
                ) AS Launch_Discount_LY
            FROM {sales_table} s
            LEFT JOIN {product_attribute_table} p
                ON ({join})
            WHERE week_id >= {compare_start_week_id}
            AND week_id <= {compare_end_week_id}
            {filter_condition}
            AND s.clearance_flag = false
            AND p.product_identifier = "new_style"
        )
        SELECT 
            Launch_Discount_TY*100 AS Launch_Discount_TY,
            Launch_Discount_LY*100 AS Launch_Discount_LY,
            (Launch_Discount_TY - Launch_Discount_LY)*100 AS Launch_Discount_LY_variance
        FROM ThisYear 
        CROSS JOIN LastYear

{% elif config['loc_lower_level'] not in loc_level and config['prod_lower_level'] in prod_level %}

        WITH
        base_data AS (
            SELECT
                week_id,
                s.{{store_code}},
                SUM(s.discount_amount) AS total_discount,
                SUM(s.sales + s.discount_amount) AS total_msrp,
                SUM(s.sales) AS total_sales,  
                CASE
                    WHEN week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id} AND week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id} THEN 'TY'
                    WHEN week_id >= {compare_start_week_id} AND week_id <= {compare_end_week_id} THEN 'LY'
                END AS period_type
            FROM
                {sales_table} s
            LEFT JOIN {product_attribute_table} p
                ON ({join})
            WHERE
                ((week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id} AND week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id})
                OR (week_id >= {compare_start_week_id} AND week_id <= {compare_end_week_id}))
                {filter_condition}
                AND s.clearance_flag = FALSE
                AND p.product_identifier = "new_style"
            GROUP BY
                {{store_code}},
                week_id
        ),
        -- This Year (TY) calculations
        ty_store_metrics AS (
            SELECT
                {{store_code}},
                SUM(total_msrp) AS store_total_msrp,
                SUM(total_sales) AS store_total_sales,  
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_discount), SUM(total_msrp)) AS store_launch_discount_percentage
            FROM
                base_data
            WHERE
                period_type = 'TY'
            GROUP BY
                {{store_code}}
        ),
        ty_launch_discount AS (
            SELECT
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(store_launch_discount_percentage * store_total_sales), SUM(store_total_sales)) AS Launch_Discount_TY
            FROM
                ty_store_metrics
        ),
        ty_final AS (
            SELECT
                tld.Launch_Discount_TY,  
                COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.{{store_code}}) AS total_stores_ty,
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN tsm.store_launch_discount_percentage > tld.Launch_Discount_TY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                        COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.{{store_code}})) * 100 AS pct_stores_above_launch_discount_ty,
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN tsm.store_launch_discount_percentage < tld.Launch_Discount_TY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                        COUNT(DISTINCT tsm.{{store_code}})) * 100 AS pct_stores_below_launch_discount_ty
            FROM
                ty_launch_discount tld
            CROSS JOIN
                ty_store_metrics tsm
            GROUP BY
                tld.Launch_Discount_TY
        ),
        -- Last Year (LY) calculations
        ly_store_metrics AS (
            SELECT
                {{store_code}},
                SUM(total_msrp) AS store_total_msrp,
                SUM(total_sales) AS store_total_sales, 
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_discount), SUM(total_msrp)) AS store_launch_discount_percentage
            FROM
                base_data
            WHERE
                period_type = 'LY'
            GROUP BY
                {{store_code}}
        ),
        ly_launch_discount AS (
            SELECT
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(store_launch_discount_percentage * store_total_sales), SUM(store_total_sales)) AS Launch_Discount_LY
            FROM
                ly_store_metrics
        ),
        ly_final AS (
            SELECT
                lld.Launch_Discount_LY,
                COUNT(DISTINCT lsm.{{store_code}}) AS total_stores_ly,
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN lsm.store_launch_discount_percentage > lld.Launch_Discount_LY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                        COUNT(DISTINCT lsm.{{store_code}})) * 100 AS pct_stores_above_launch_discount_ly,
                SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN lsm.store_launch_discount_percentage < lld.Launch_Discount_LY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                        COUNT(DISTINCT lsm.{{store_code}})) * 100 AS pct_stores_below_launch_discount_ly
            FROM
                ly_launch_discount lld
            CROSS JOIN
                ly_store_metrics lsm
            GROUP BY
                lld.Launch_Discount_LY
        )
        -- Final results using CROSS JOIN
        SELECT
            ty.Launch_Discount_TY*100 as Launch_Discount_TY,
            ty.pct_stores_above_launch_discount_ty,
            ty.pct_stores_below_launch_discount_ty,
            ly.Launch_Discount_LY*100 as Launch_Discount_LY,
            ly.pct_stores_above_launch_discount_ly,
            ly.pct_stores_below_launch_discount_ly,
            (ty.Launch_Discount_TY - ly.Launch_Discount_LY) * 100 AS Launch_Discount_LY_Variance,
            ty.pct_stores_above_launch_discount_ty - ly.pct_stores_above_launch_discount_ly AS pct_stores_above_launch_discount_variance,
            ty.pct_stores_below_launch_discount_ty - ly.pct_stores_below_launch_discount_ly AS pct_stores_below_launch_discount_variance
        FROM
            ty_final ty
        CROSS JOIN
            ly_final ly

WITH ThisYear AS (

        SAFE_DIVIDE(

        ) AS Markdown_TY
    FROM {sales_table}
    WHERE week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}
    AND week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id}
    {filter_condition}

),

    SELECT 
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            SUM(discount_amount), 
            SUM(sales + discount_amount)
        ) AS Markdown_LY
    FROM {sales_table}
    WHERE week_id >= {compare_start_week_id}
    AND week_id <= {compare_end_week_id}
    {filter_condition}
    AND clearance_flag = true
)
SELECT 
    Markdown_TY*100 as Markdown_TY,
    Markdown_LY*100 as Markdown_LY,
    (Markdown_TY - Markdown_LY) *100 AS Markdown_PCT_LY_variance

query_string:
{% set store_code = config['loc_lower_level'] %}

{% if config['loc_lower_level'] not in loc_level %}

WITH current_year_data AS (
    SELECT 
        {{store_code}} AS store_code,
        {hierarchy_list}
        quantity,
        sales
    FROM 
        {sales_table}
    WHERE 
        week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id} 
        AND week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id}
        {filter_condition}
),
aggregated_stores_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        store_code,
        SUM(sales) AS total_sales,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM 
        current_year_data
    GROUP BY 
        store_code
),
cumulative_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        store_code,
        total_sales,
        total_quantity,
        SUM(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS cum_sales
    FROM 
        aggregated_stores_sales
),
store_code AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.store_code
    FROM 
        cumulative_sales cs
    WHERE 
        cs.cum_sales <= 0.8 * (SELECT MAX(c.cum_sales) FROM cumulative_sales c)
    LIMIT 50
),
curr_year_data AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(ags.total_sales) AS current_total_sales,
        SUM(ags.total_quantity) AS current_total_quantity,
        (SELECT COUNT(sc.store_code) from store_code sc) as store_count
    FROM 
        aggregated_stores_sales ags
    WHERE 
        ags.store_code IN (SELECT sc.store_code FROM store_code sc)
),
comp_year_data AS (
    SELECT 
        {hierarchy_list}
        SUM(sales) AS compare_total_sales, 
        SUM(quantity) AS compare_total_quantity
    FROM 
        {sales_table}
    WHERE 
        week_id >= {compare_start_week_id} 
        AND week_id <= {compare_end_week_id} AND store_code in (SELECT sc.store_code FROM store_code sc)
        {filter_condition}
)
SELECT 
    cyd.store_count,
    cyd.current_total_sales,
    cod.compare_total_sales,
    cyd.current_total_quantity,
    cod.compare_total_quantity
FROM 
    comp_year_data cod,
    curr_year_data cyd

{% else %}

WITH current_data AS (
    SELECT 
        quantity,
        sales
    FROM 
        {sales_table}
    WHERE 
        week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id} 
        AND week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id}
        {filter_condition}
),
compare_data AS (
    SELECT 
        quantity,
        sales
    FROM 
        {sales_table}
    WHERE 
        week_id >= {compare_start_week_id} 
        AND week_id <= {compare_end_week_id}
        {filter_condition}
),
cur_data AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(sales) AS current_total_sales, 
        SUM(quantity) AS current_total_quantity 
    FROM 
        current_data
),
comp_data AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(sales) AS compare_total_sales, 
        SUM(quantity) AS compare_total_quantity 
    FROM 
        compare_data
)
SELECT 
    cu.current_total_sales,
    cu.current_total_quantity,
    co.compare_total_sales,
    co.compare_total_quantity 
FROM 
    cur_data cu,
    comp_data co

{% endif %}

{% set style = config['prod_lower_level'] %}
{% set store_code = config['loc_lower_level'] %}

WITH current_period_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.week_id,
        {{ store_code }} as store_code,
        {{ style }} as style,
        SUM(ss.sales) AS total_sales
    FROM {sales_table} ss
    JOIN {comparable_calendar} cc ON ss.week_id = cc.week_id
    WHERE ss.week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}
      AND ss.week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id}
      {filter_condition}
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
event_sales_current AS (
    SELECT
        cp.week_id,
        SUM(total_sales) AS event_sales,
    FROM current_period_sales cp
    JOIN {comparable_calendar} cc ON cp.week_id = cc.week_id
    WHERE cc.Event_name != 'No_event'
    GROUP BY cp.week_id
),
event_weeks_check AS (
    SELECT COUNT(1) AS event_week_count
    FROM event_sales_current
),
sum_event_sales_current AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(event_sales) AS overall_sum_event_sales,
        AVG(event_sales) AS event_sales_avg  -- Added for comparison in final SELECT
    FROM event_sales_current
),
non_event_sales_current AS (
    SELECT
        cp.week_id,
        SUM(total_sales) AS non_event_sales
    FROM current_period_sales cp
    JOIN {comparable_calendar} cc ON cp.week_id = cc.week_id
    WHERE cc.Event_name = 'No_event'
    GROUP BY cp.week_id
),
sum_non_event_sales_current AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(non_event_sales) AS overall_avg_non_event_sales,
        STDDEV_SAMP(non_event_sales) AS non_event_sales_stddev
    FROM non_event_sales_current
),
comparable_period_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.week_id,
        {{ store_code }} as store_code,
        {{ style }} as style,
        SUM(ss.sales) AS total_sales
    FROM {sales_table} ss
    JOIN {comparable_calendar} cc ON ss.week_id = cc.LY_comparable
    WHERE ss.week_id >= {compare_start_week_id}
      AND ss.week_id <= {compare_end_week_id}
      {filter_condition}
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
event_sales_comparable AS (
    SELECT
        cps.week_id,
        SUM(total_sales) AS event_sales
    FROM comparable_period_sales cps
    JOIN {comparable_calendar} cc ON cps.week_id = cc.LY_comparable
    WHERE cc.Event_name != 'No_event'
    GROUP BY cps.week_id
),
sum_event_sales_comparable AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(event_sales) AS overall_sum_event_sales
    FROM event_sales_comparable
),
event_weeks_check_comparable AS (
    SELECT COUNT(1) AS event_week_count
    FROM event_sales_comparable
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT event_week_count FROM event_weeks_check) = 0 
        THEN NULL
        ELSE sum_event_sales_current.overall_sum_event_sales
    END AS event_TY,
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT event_week_count FROM event_weeks_check_comparable ) = 0 
        THEN NULL
        ELSE sum_event_sales_comparable.overall_sum_event_sales
    END AS event_LY,
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT event_week_count FROM event_weeks_check) = 0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN sum_event_sales_comparable.overall_sum_event_sales > 0
                THEN (sum_event_sales_current.overall_sum_event_sales - sum_event_sales_comparable.overall_sum_event_sales) / sum_event_sales_comparable.overall_sum_event_sales * 100
                ELSE NULL
            END
    END AS event_LY_variance,

    CASE
        -- Use sum_event_sales_current for the event_sales_avg comparison
        WHEN sum_event_sales_current.event_sales_avg > sum_non_event_sales_current.overall_avg_non_event_sales + sum_non_event_sales_current.non_event_sales_stddev
        THEN 'High-performance'
        WHEN sum_event_sales_current.event_sales_avg < sum_non_event_sales_current.overall_avg_non_event_sales - sum_non_event_sales_current.non_event_sales_stddev
        THEN 'Low-performance'
        ELSE 'Normal-performance'
    END AS performance_flag
FROM sum_event_sales_current
JOIN sum_non_event_sales_current ON 1=1
JOIN sum_event_sales_comparable ON 1=1;

{% if config['loc_lower_level'] in loc_level and config['prod_lower_level'] in prod_level %}

WITH ThisYear AS (
    SELECT 
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            SUM(discount_amount), 
            SUM(sales + discount_amount)
        ) AS Promo_TY
    FROM {sales_table}
    WHERE week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}
    AND week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id}
    {filter_condition}
    AND clearance_flag = false
),
LastYear AS (
    SELECT 
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            SUM(discount_amount), 
            SUM(sales + discount_amount)
        ) AS Promo_LY
    FROM {sales_table}
    WHERE week_id >= {compare_start_week_id}
    AND week_id <= {compare_end_week_id}
    {filter_condition}
    AND clearance_flag = false
)
SELECT 
    Promo_TY*100 as Promo_TY,
    Promo_LY*100 as Promo_LY,
    (Promo_TY - Promo_LY) *100 AS Promo_PCT_LY_variance
FROM ThisYear CROSS JOIN LastYear

{% set style = config['prod_lower_level'] %}
    {% set store_code = config['loc_lower_level'] %}

    with current_data as (
        select
            week_id,
            {{store_code}} as store_code,
            {{style}} as style,
            {hierarchy_list}
            quantity,
            sales,
            margin,
            case 
                when quantity > 0 then (sales - margin) / quantity
                else 0
            end as unit_cost,
            quantity/sum(quantity) over (partition by week_id) as qty_weight
        from {sales_table}
        where week_id between {timeline_start_week_id} and {timeline_end_week_id}
        {filter_condition}
    ),
    cur_qty_total as (
        select sum(quantity) as total_qty
        from current_data
    ),
    cur_agg_cost as (
        select 
            week_id,
            sum(qty_weight*unit_cost)*sum(quantity)/(select total_qty from cur_qty_total) as avg_cost
        from current_data
        group by week_id
    ),
    cur_total as (
        select sum(avg_cost) as cur_cogs
        from cur_agg_cost
    ),
    comp_data as (
        select
            week_id,
            {{store_code}} as store_code,
            {{style}} as style,
            {hierarchy_list}
            quantity,
            sales,
            margin,
            case 
                when quantity > 0 then (sales - margin) / quantity
                else 0
            end as unit_cost,
            quantity/sum(quantity) over (partition by week_id) as qty_weight
        from {sales_table}
        where week_id between {compare_start_week_id} and {compare_end_week_id}
        {filter_condition}
    ),
    comp_qty_total as (
        select sum(quantity) as total_qty
        from comp_data
    ),
    comp_agg_cost as (
        select 
            week_id,
            sum(qty_weight*unit_cost)*sum(quantity)/(select total_qty from comp_qty_total) as avg_cost
        from comp_data
        group by week_id
    ),
    comp_total as (
        select sum(avg_cost) as com_cogs
        from comp_agg_cost
    )
    select
        cur_total.cur_cogs as cogs_TY,
        comp_total.com_cogs as cogs_LY,
        case
            when abs(comp_total.com_cogs) > 0
            then (cur_total.cur_cogs - comp_total.com_cogs) / abs(comp_total.com_cogs) * 100
            else null
        end as cogs_LY_variance 
    from cur_total, comp_total

with TY as (
    select
    {hierachy_list} --dynamic
    {kpi_formula} as {kpi_name}  --dynamic
    from `{table_name}` s
    where 
    s.week_id <= {timeline_end_week_id} and s.week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}  {filter_condition}  --dynamic
    {hierachy_list_group_by}  --dynamic
    )
    ,PY as (
    select
    {hierachy_list} --dynamic
    {planned_kpi_formula} as {planned_kpi_name}  --dynamic
    from `{planned_table_name}` s
    where s.week_id <= {plantime_end_week_id} and s.week_id >= {plantime_start_week_id}  {filter_condition}   --dynamic
    {hierachy_list_group_by}

    )
    ,LY as (
    select
    {hierachy_list} --dynamic
    {kpi_formula} as {kpi_name}  --dynamic
    from `{table_name}` s
    where s.week_id <= {compare_end_week_id} and s.week_id >= {compare_start_week_id}  {filter_condition}   --dynamic
    {hierachy_list_group_by}
    )
    select
    {combined_coalesce_list}
    round(TY.{kpi_name}, 2) as {kpi_name}_TY
    ,round((safe_divide((TY.{kpi_name}-LY.{kpi_name}),LY.{kpi_name}))*100,2) as {kpi_name}_percentage_LY_Variance
    ,round((safe_divide((TY.{kpi_name}-PY.{planned_kpi_name}),PY.{planned_kpi_name}))*100,2) as {kpi_name}_percentage_Plan_Variance
    from TY
    full outer join LY 
    on {full_join_ly} --dynamic
    full outer join PY 
    on {full_join_py} --dynamic

        {inventory_subset_table} i

        s.week_id = i.week_id
        AND s.store_code = i.{{store_code}} 
        AND s.style = i.{{style}}
    WHERE
        ((i.week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}

        s.style ),
        
    sell_through_data_current AS (

        max(week_id) as ty_end_period,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(sum(total_sales), sum(total_sales + total_eoh))*100 AS sell_through_rate_TY
        FROM
        sales_inventory_data

        week_id >= {timeline_start_week_id}

        FROM
        sales_inventory_data
        WHERE
        week_id >= {compare_start_week_id}

    SELECT *
    FROM {sales_table}
    WHERE week_id BETWEEN {timeline_start_week_id} AND {timeline_end_week_id}
    {filter_condition}
),
sales_cte_ly AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM {sales_table}
    WHERE week_id BETWEEN {compare_start_week_id} AND {compare_end_week_id}
    {filter_condition}
),
transaction_counts_ty AS (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT transactionid_part) AS transaction_count
    FROM sales_cte_ty s
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(SPLIT(s.transactionid, '$')) AS transactionid_part
),
transaction_counts_ly AS (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT transactionid_part) AS transaction_count
    FROM sales_cte_ly s
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(SPLIT(s.transactionid, '$')) AS transactionid_part
),
aggregated_quantity_ty AS (
    SELECT week_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM sales_cte_ty
    GROUP BY week_id
),
aggregated_quantity_ly AS (
    SELECT week_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM sales_cte_ly
    GROUP BY week_id
),
basket_size_ty AS (
    SELECT
      SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(s.total_quantity), MIN(t.transaction_count)) AS `Basket Size TY`
    FROM aggregated_quantity_ty s
    CROSS JOIN transaction_counts_ty t
